phase: EVRYN Phase 1.5 — Relation Recall, Annotation Alignment, and Confidence Calibration
protocol: Zero-Leakage Split Isolation with Multi-Version Benchmark Reporting (Strict separation of Train, Dev, Locked Test, and External Generalization)

v1.name: Historical Phase 2 Benchmark
v1.description: Original benchmark manifest preserved without modification. PMC2816692 retains legacy Anthrax annotations.

v2.name: Authenticated Curated Benchmark V2
v2.description: Authenticated real-paper annotations for PMC2816692 from genuine Salmonella enterica SrcA XML text and corrected title string for PMC2774163.

root_cause_audit.issue: BioCause Standoff Self-Referential Fallback (PhoQ -> PhoQ, Mlc -> Mlc)
root_cause_audit.root_cause: In evryn/datasets/biocause.py, line 154 parsed event arguments using `args.get('Effect') or args.get('Cause')`. BioNLP Shared Task format encodes regulatory events as `Regulation:Trigger Theme:Target Cause:Agent`. The regulated target is specified under `Theme`, not `Effect`. Since `args.get('Effect')` was None, the parser fell back to `Cause`, producing 366 self-referential relations (e.g. PhoQ -> PhoQ) across 417 relations (87.8% corpus corruption).
root_cause_audit.resolution: Implemented recursive standoff event dereferencing in BioCauseDataset._load_standoff. When an argument is a nested event (e.g., Gene_expression:E2 or Regulation:E3), the parser recursively resolves the nested Theme to extract the true underlying entity target. Rebuilt real-paper examples cache without self-loops.

experiments.name: Exp A: Extended Reverse Regulatory Triggers ('requires', 'promoted by', 'abolished by')
experiments.hypothesis: Biological literature frequently asserts upstream requirements using reverse-dependency phrasing ('Activation of PmrA requires PhoQ'). Standard SVO extraction treats 'Activation of PmrA' as Cause and 'PhoQ' as Effect (reversed). Recognizing 'requires' as a passive/reverse dependency correctly inverts directionality to Cause -> Effect (PhoQ -> PmrA). Adding 'promoted by', 'abolished by', and 'abolishes' recovers regulatory relations missed by standard triggers.
experiments.implementation: Added reverse-dependency trigger `(?<!\bis\s)(?<!\bwas\s)(?<!\bare\s)(?<!\bwere\s)\b(?:requires?|requiring)\b` to PASSIVE_INDICATORS. Added 'promoted by' and 'abolished by'. Expanded INHIBITION_PATTERNS with 'abolishes/abolished/abolishing'. Permitted adverbial intercalation before 'by'. Added ablation toggle enable_extended_triggers.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Increases Train Direct F1 from 0.2996 to 0.3306 (+10.3% relative gain) while recovering target biomedical regulatory edges.

experiments.name: Exp B: Multi-Cause Conjoined Phrase Extraction ('both X and Y')
experiments.hypothesis: Biomedical papers frequently document dual regulatory inputs using conjoined noun phrases ('requires both PmrA's cognate sensor kinase PmrB... and PmrD'). Standard extractors previously only parsed effect conjunctions while discarding secondary cause conjuncts, and severed clauses prematurely at parenthetical commas. Parsing cause conjuncts and protecting 'both ... and ...' clauses from comma truncation enables extraction of multiple upstream regulators.
experiments.implementation: Extended _parse_conjoined_phrases to cause noun phrases in _extract_syntactic_assertions. Protected comma boundaries within 'both ... and ...' spans. Added ablation toggle enable_conjoined_causes.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted as complementary capability. When combined with genitive descriptor stripping, accurately extracts both PmrB and PmrD from conjoined parenthetical structures.

experiments.name: Exp C: Genitive Biological Role Descriptor Stripping & Synonyms
experiments.hypothesis: Biomedical text frequently prefaces protein entities with genitive functional descriptors (e.g., 'PmrA's cognate sensor kinase PmrB' or 'PhoQ's cognate regulator PhoP'). These verbose noun phrases fail to match gold annotations ('PmrB', 'PhoP'). Stripping genitive role descriptions canonicalizes mentions to primary molecular entities.
experiments.implementation: Added genitive descriptor normalization in PaperEntityNormalizer.canonicalize (stripping "X's [adjectives] role_noun Y" to "Y"). Expanded GLOBAL_SYNONYMS for SPI1-T3SS, PhoQ/PhoP, and PmrA/PmrB. Added ablation toggle enable_genitive_stripping.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Produces clean molecular entities in PMC1804205 and downstream BioCause evaluations.

experiments.name: Exp D: Cross-Page Confidence Calibration
experiments.hypothesis: Evaluating whether lowering CrossPageLinker min_confidence from 0.58 to 0.55 improves multi-page recall without diluting precision.
experiments.implementation: Evaluated Dev and Train splits with min_confidence = 0.55 vs 0.58 baseline.
experiments.conclusion: Rejected. min_confidence = 0.55 decreased Dev Cross-Page F1 from 0.3405 to 0.3359 due to slight precision dilution. Preserved 0.58 as optimal calibrated threshold.

experiments.name: Exp E: Combined Phase 1.5 Pipeline
experiments.hypothesis: Synergistic combination of extended reverse triggers, multi-cause conjoined extraction, and genitive descriptor stripping delivers higher recall on Train and Dev without sacrificing precision.
experiments.implementation: Integrated all accepted improvements into extractor.py and normalizer.py.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Frozen as the final Phase 1.5 release.
